description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) pre-sign security firewall evaluating EVM transaction risks, calldata decoding, unlimited token approvals, Permit2 signatures, EIP-712 typed data phishing, Indirect Prompt Injections in untrusted calldata/descriptions, and simulated state changes via eth_call. Returns JSON with verdict (ALLOW, BLOCK, MANUAL_REVIEW), risk_score (0.0-10.0), reasons, and simulation details.

chain_id.description: EVM Chain ID (default: 8453 for Base Mainnet)

eip712_typed_data.description: Optional EIP-712 typed data dictionary to inspect before signing

run_simulation.description: Whether to run eth_call simulation on chain

to_address.description: Target contract or recipient EVM address

untrusted_text.description: Optional untrusted text or proposal description to scan for prompt injection

name: preflight_tx_firewall
